title: Russian forces strike Omega Telecom data center in Kiev
summary: The company is one of the largest providers of high-speed internet services to the Ukrainian armed forces, including the storage of large volumes of databases, the ministry said

title: Cargo ship carrying military equipment to Odessa port struck at sea
summary: In addition, a cargo ship carrying military equipment and dual-use goods to the port of Odessa to support the Ukrainian armed forces was struck while at sea, the ministry said
